name: PDF Snapshot Archive API
description: Extends the REDCap API to list and download items from the PDF Snapshot Archive folder of the File Repository.

get-items.description: Returns every attribute, except the file itself, of every item in the PDF Snapshot Archive visible to the token's user. Optionally narrow the result with item_ids and/or records, each given as an array or a comma-separated list. Supports returnFormat json, csv, or xml.

get-file.description: Downloads the PDF file of the PDF Snapshot Archive item specified by item_id.
